Hi Elena / Tom —

Congrats on another strong quarter. As we discussed in our mid-June call, your renewal window opens in Aug and our standard approach is to run a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align goals, owners, success criteria, and a close timeline. I put together an initial kickoff note below and a one-page MAP draft attached.

Goal of kick-off: confirm stakeholders and success criteria for renewal + identify opportunities (usage-based upsell or new feature add-ons) so we can scope commercial options and timeline.

Proposed 30-day plan (high level):
- Week 1 (this week): Stakeholder alignment, usage review, define success metrics (SLA, throughput, latency for key flows).
- Week 2: Tech/implementation checklist (SSO, network, observability), pilot/POC outcomes if any.
- Week 3: Commercial proposal & optional upsell packaging discussion.
- Week 4: Finalize contract redlines and procurement steps.

Proposed owners from Redwood:
- Dylan Brooks (Account lead) — overall MAP owner, pricing & rollout options
- Marcus Lin (Solutions/Performance) — technical validation & observability acceptance
- Monica Patel (Customer Success) — adoption & usage ops
- Lauren Bishop (Sales Ops) — procurement and quotes

Can you confirm the right Skyline stakeholders to include? From our notes I have you (Elena), Tom Bell (Platform lead), and Procurement (procurement@skylinehealth.com). If there are others (security/compliance, SRE, purchasing) please flag.

Timing: are you available for a 45-minute kickoff the week of Jul 27? I can send a calendar invite once we lock attendees/time.

Attached: redwood_renewal_map_v1.pdf (draft MAP outline).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.
